criteria.task: One or more NEW tasks the user wants to do or add, including sending a message as a task.
criteria.none: No new task: observation, past/completed action, note, information question, unfinished fragment, or request to update existing tasks.
criteria.uncertain: Unclear whether the user wants new tasks.

coverage.instructions: Assuming `text` requests new tasks: do `candidates` together represent every intended task as a separate readable title, without losing important content? Ignore dates removed from titles. Evaluate shared objects/verbs carefully. Cancelled candidates can be excluded later.

criteria.complete: Every requested task is represented and titles are usable.
criteria.incomplete: A task is missing, a title is incomplete/incorrect, or multiple distinct tasks remain combined in one title.

task_0.instructions: In the full context of text, should candidate 0 ({"source":"掃除タスクを完了にして","title":"掃除タスクを完了にして"}) be proposed as a NEW task? Consider corrections and negations across the whole input. Exclude fragments, cancelled actions, past actions and explicit refusals to create a task.

criteria.include: This title represents an intended new task.
criteria.exclude: This is cancelled, superseded, not a new task, or not a complete actionable title.

date_0.instructions: Assuming candidate 0 ({"source":"掃除タスクを完了にして","title":"掃除タスクを完了にして"}) is a task, select the final intended due date for it from dates. Respect corrections, per-task scope, and shared deadlines. A mentioned time/date is not necessarily a deadline. Choose unsupported when timing cannot be fully represented as a single calendar date (time of day, recurring schedule, vague/range deadline).

criteria.unsupported: A requested deadline is ambiguous, invalid, recurring, includes a specific time, or is not in dates.
